notes: Multi-step question set for the Level 2 planner (plan 5.9, Phase 7). Run it on the SYNTHETIC set made from the sample: tmp-pipeline-synthetic out/sha256-... out_synth/, then tmp-pipeline-qa tests/data/gold/sample.multistep.questions.json --out out_synth --planner (and --no-planner to compare).

The synthetic set holds KTS 26-1581 V1 (the real sample), KTS 26-1581 V2 (end date 2026-11-11, temporary speed limit 40 km/h; made by text replacement) and KTS 26-1702 V1 (the sample moved to 12 Beach Road, Browns Bay). Questions are asked on V2, the latest version, unless session is null.

Keyed by the planner's author from the stored facts, not by an independent reader; the multi-TMP questions only test retrieval and the planner, never extraction. The planner needs --model replay or live: with the model off every question stays Level 1.

questions.question: Which stages run 24x7, and what are the weekend shift times?
Who designed the TMP, and have they signed it?
Is the temporary speed limit in force at 7am on a Saturday, and who do we call if the work runs late?
Who is the activity manager and have they signed the TMP?
What changed between V1 and V2 of this TMP?
How many days longer does V2 run than V1?
Did the temporary speed limit change in V2, and by how much?
Which TMPs are active in October 2026, and which of them are fully approved?
Which TMPs are there across all sites, and what is the temporary speed limit on each?
Which TMPs are on Beach Road, and who is their contractor?
